registered_manifest.scope_override_note: The generator has no ONE_OFF_GLOBAL mode; its complete all-country work-unit list is used unchanged under this explicit one-off scope.

country_discovery.selection_source: World Bank indicator NY.GDP.MKTP.CD, 2024 current US dollars; all registered catalog countries are included first, then highest-GDP registry markets.

source_query_budget.registered_catalogs: One authorized robots policy check per unique host and one canonical Catalog Promo URL attempt per manifest work unit; at most two retries for transient failures; finite 30-second request timeout; no CAPTCHA or access bypass.
source_query_budget.country_discovery: Up to one official catalog-promotion search and one online-shop/marketplace discovery search per selected market; open at most one qualifying official lead per search; public pages only.
source_query_budget.online_offer_review: Bounded to public items directly discoverable on approved merchant pages; never use Google Shopping snippets as price evidence; new sellers remain audit-only pending catalog approval.

historical_baseline_note: The base includes the earlier PR #55 highlights run audit (commit 0dfc9d92229824606aea6a7becbc79089d82145b). That audit is historical context, not receipts for this Issue #57 run; Issue #57 requires the expanded market-discovery phase and per-source checkpoints.
baseline_validation_note: The Windows checkout initially converted JSON feeds to CRLF under system core.autocrlf=true, so local byte hashes appeared different although every index SHA matched the committed Git blob. After testing canonical Git blob bytes, validate.py --as-of 2026-11-23 --strict-expiry returned VALID with zero expired items in all seven feeds. Default timezone lookup is unavailable in the host Python 3.15 because tzdata is not installed; the explicit date was used for the baseline check. No production feed/index changes were made.
